outcome: prevalence of allergic diseases during pregnancy
cohort: 1,603 pregnant women were enrolled prior to the 24th week of pregnancy from Mobini Hospital in Iran.
finding: The prevalence of asthma during pregnancy was 2.1%, with significant relationships observed between asthmatic status and age, education, place of living, asthma symptoms, and other allergic diseases such as eczema, rhinitis, and wheeze.
